title: Hazardous materials shipping paper
description: A shipping paper for a hazardous load as the carrier keeps it: shipper, carrier, the hazardous materials description lines (UN number, proper shipping name, hazard class, packing group, quantity), the emergency response telephone number and a note on where the paper is carried. The guide number is optional and is typed by the author from their own copy of the guidebook.

agency.description: Agency or unit that keeps this record.

incidentName.description: Incident name as command announced it.
examples: Tank car leak at Harlan Spur

marking.description: Exercise marking printed at the top and bottom. Defaults to the standard exercise marking.

documentNumber.description: Bill of lading or waybill number.

carriedIn.description: Where the paper is kept, such as the cab pouch or the conductor's bag.

unNumber.description: UN or NA number with prefix.

name.description: Proper shipping name as written on the paper.

packingGroup.description: Packing group (I, II or III) or blank.

guide.description: Guide number typed from the author's own copy of the guidebook; leave blank otherwise.

notes.description: Remarks such as inhalation hazard marks, residue or reportable quantity.
